constraints: ZDR: a RoutingDecision is ids and enums only (content-free like turn_timing and the proof bundle) so it may be recorded on ZDR runs; a ReplayEnvelope holds provider-signed reasoning content and must never be persisted on ZDR turns (with_head_summary returns early on zdr as the precedent). Plane ownership: the resolver belongs in Model Plane; a Space default is a preference owned by the Application Plane projection and an org default belongs in Control Plane org settings (the Convex organizations.defaultModel field feeds a legacy AI Core path, INF), and both are only inputs: inference-core must still enforce entitlement, ZDR and the privacy-tier floor (provider_meets_privacy_tier), so a default can never widen access. Pinned models are never substituted today and a subscription-pinned agent route ends the run on a mismatch, so lifecycle successor mapping must not apply to pinned subscription routes or privacy-floored requests, and any successor use must be recorded per run.
approachAdjustment: Split into three. (1) Stamp: extend intent::Decision with reason codes and carry it on USAGE_ENVELOPE, the usage SSE/ServedBy frame and the assistant-message metadata chain; render model and reason in the existing Details popover (the served-by line is the privacy line, not the model line). (2) Resolver and lifecycle: one resolve_model() called by the inference-core intent layer and execution-core ModelRoute, with lifecycle fields on ModelInfo; Space and org defaults as inputs. (3) Replay envelope: defer until a native tool-block message type or a Gemini adapter exists, because ChatMessage must first carry content blocks. Drop 'persist on every run step in Session Core': there is no per-inference step table (plan_steps are plan items); use message/run metadata or the event log.
effortNote: Kept L for the whole item; the stamp plus display is M, resolver plus lifecycle is M to L, and the replay envelope (M) should be deferred, so the near-term slice is M.
verdictReason: Request-level routing, model_used on the done frame, the Details popover model row and the cost-ledger model all exist, so the item must be stated as extending them. Two parts are misdescribed: replay is not required for correct tool use under the current text-flattened tool loop, and per-step persistence in Session Core has no table to land on.

constraints: ZDR: every bundle or report must be content-free on ZDR and temporary runs (the proof bundle already excludes final_output and error; turn_timing is ids and counts), and a ZDR thread has nothing retained to export. Plane ownership: thread export must read through Model Plane transcript/event APIs with owner-read authorization, never another plane's database, and DSAR/erasure stays a Control Plane concern (privacy-client text says Model Plane conversations are outside it); Space-owned threads must use the Space transcript route so a Space never widens an owner ACL. Egress: the existing feedback path mirrors reports into the team's monitored org, so attaching a support bundle needs per-section consent and scrubbing. Detection over the audit stream depends on audit delivery actually working (postmortem 0002, fix not deployed as of 2026-10-06; F-t3-004). A customer-hosted policy hook sends content to a customer endpoint and conflicts with ZDR, residency and sovereign tiers. A public event API needs Control Plane-issued API credentials, since model-gateway accepts only auth-core JWTs.
approachAdjustment: Reword as four small additions on existing pieces: (a) per-thread export built client-side from the transcript and thread-events APIs and the existing zip writer; (b) turn the existing 'Give feedback' dialog into 'Report a problem' by attaching run and request id and scrubbed client errors (the gateway has no request-id propagation today, so mint one or reuse the run id); (c) a proof-bundle JSON download in Run Console and Trace, with a correlation id added to RunProvenance; (d) a PerformanceObserver and window error reporter posting to a gateway endpoint beside observability.rs. Carve out the versioned public event API (hardening the existing OpenAPI plus API-key auth) and audit-stream detection (blocked on F-t3-004) as separate later items, seed the guide skill through the existing registry, and drop the customer policy hook (documentation-only evidence, 1 of 12, conflicts with ZDR and sovereignty).
effortNote: M holds only for the four reduced pieces, each small; the full seven-part bundle as written would be L or more because the public API and detection rules are each separate efforts.
verdictReason: Roughly half of the bundle exists in some form (feedback dialog, proof bundle view, run-event SSE with OpenAPI and SDKs, per-answer export, skill registry), so the item should extend those rather than describe them as new. The customer policy hook has no basis in this architecture and the detection and public-API pieces are separate dependencies.
